name: trustcomm-launch-video
description: trustcomm launch motion-graphics film built with HyperFrames + GSAP

scripts.render: cd trustcomm-launch && hyperframes render --quality standard --output renders/video-silent.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i renders/video-silent.mp4 -i assets/audio/mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest renders/trustcomm-launch.mp4
